_source: Stage 5c family movement (roadmap step 1; decided 2026-11-13: walking inside a room is shown only and costs no simulation time). Distances in METRES on each room's real floor (2026-11-20: rooms of real sizes, rooms.json size_m; converted from floor units at 5 m, a mid-sized room). walk_speed: metres per game minute. catch_up_minutes: when the route left is longer than walk_speed covers in this time, people walk faster so the view never trails the simulation by more. max_rush: nobody moves faster than this many times their own pace, even when catching up (2026-11-15). stagger_minutes: when several people set off on the same room-to-room route at once, each next one leaves this much later. Each person's pace (schedules: pace) and the run-down-room slowdown (rules.json: people_slowest) scale both walk_speed and catch_up_minutes (2026-11-15). door_inset: how far inside a door someone arriving stops. cell_m: walking grid cell size in metres (each room gets as many cells as fit). clearance: a person's half width, added around every footprint. footprints: [half width, half depth] in metres each furniture kind blocks; kinds not listed (rugs, windows, the front door) are walked over; pieces marked decor in furniture.json never block (their size here is only used to check no route crosses them). All values are provisional tuning (roadmap step 4).
